items.description: Translation from Spanish to English, 2 hrs
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f): translation of police reports and supporting documents for the claim is not indemnifiable, even if necessary for substantiation.
Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f): working materials and ancillary charges for translation are not indemnifiable.

items.description: Compensation for stolen watch (premium replacement model, upgrade on the one taken)
items.rationale: 7.1.1, 7.1.9, 4.2.2, 6.3: Only the value of the watch actually taken is indemnified, capped at the valuables sub-limit of €2,500 per item. Upgrades are not covered; indemnity is for a like-for-like replacement or the sub-limit, whichever is lower.

items.description: Compensation for cash taken in robbery
items.rationale: 4.2.3, 4.2.4, 6.3, 7.1.1: Cash is covered as a means of payment, but indemnity is capped at €500 per event for cash, even if more was lost.

items.description: Replacement of designer sunglasses (mislaid separately, not taken in robbery)
items.rationale: 2.3.4(a), 7.1.5: Sunglasses were not taken in the insured event but mislaid separately; not an affected item, so not indemnified.
7.1.8(b): Shipping, carriage, and comparable charges are not indemnified, even if related to replacement property.
